changes.title: Famed climber dead in Pakistan avalanche; search for others ongoing
changes.summary: The expedition lost contact with its base camp after an avalanche struck Broad Peak as they attempted to scale the mountain.

changes.title: Nirmal Purja, Renowned Mountaineer, Is Found Dead After Pakistan Avalanche
changes.summary: The British-Nepali mountaineer was one of 10 climbers who were struck by an avalanche on Thursday on Broad Peak, one of the world’s highest mountains.
